title: Recorded dataset from the existing ReSolve simulator
dataKind: Recorded dataset downloaded from the existing simulator; instrument origin not independently verified
transformation: Five-column headerless CSV. Column 1 divided by 60 for minutes, inferred from the simulator event table labelled minutes and observed duration; rawTime retained. Column 2 shown unchanged as signal in unconfirmed source units. All original rows retained in order. Columns 3–5 are retained only in the raw download; their state meanings are not inferred. Normalised display signal uses the full observed min/max.
limitations: Read-only replay of one observed simulator result. Waste bands and summary values are transcribed from the UI, not recomputed by a port of the detection algorithm. This file is not evidence of authentic instrument origin or solvent purity. Percentages are observed rounded UI outputs and need not reconcile exactly from the rounded event intervals.

settings.parameterUnits: Slope/threshold/width units not confirmed in source UI
